podcast.title: Grammy Nominee (1980)
podcast.body: Robin Williams was nominated for the Grammy for Best New Artist in 1980 but lost to Ricky Lee Jones. "She was up against the Blues Brothers, the NAC, Robin Williams and Dire Straits."

podcast.title: 70s Comedy Mega-Star
podcast.body: Robin Williams is identified as one of the comedians who became a "mega star" in the 1970s, part of an explosion of comedy clubs and television showcases like Saturday Night Live. "comedians are going to become mega stars George Carlin, Richard prior Robin Williams, Steve Martin, Cheach and Chong, Saturday night live, debuts in 1975."
